rows.jyutping: tung4 gaau3 juk6 jau5 gwaan1 ge3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that something is related to education.

example.english: This course is educational; it is related to education.
example.traditional: 呢個課程係同教育有關嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 hai6 tung4 gaau3 juk6 jau5 gwaan1 ge3

rows.jyutping: jau5 gaau3 juk6 ji3 ji6 ge3
rows.note: Use this when something teaches or has educational value, rather than merely being connected with education.

example.english: This programme is educational, and the children learn how to care for animals after watching it.
example.traditional: 呢套節目係有教育意義嘅，小朋友睇完都學識點樣愛護動物。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 zit3 muk6 hai6 jau5 gaau3 juk6 ji3 ji6 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2 jyun4 dou1 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng6 oi3 wu6 dung6 mat6
